name: El Kebeer Awi
description: Al Kabeer seeks to find love again after his wife was gone, unaware that what he is looking for is closer than he imagines.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: El Kebeer and his men enter into a battle against El Mattared, and they triumph over them, El Kebeer decides that El Mattared will not demand them for royalties anymore, because El Kebeer is the one who will demand the royalties to be doubled, and El Kebeer goes to his father El Kebeer Awe on his deathbed, and the dying father confesses to him that his mother is American named Samantha, and that he has a second brother named Johnny, and that he is coming to Mazarita, and on the day of the condolence of El Kebeer Awe, Johnny comes.‎

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: ‎Johnny comes and claims his inheritance after the death of his father, and the elder swears that nothing of his inheritance will last, and Johnny decides to run for the position of village mayor, and the elder tries to choose a sniper to kill Johnny, but what saves Johnny from death is a washing pot.‎ And he meets Hagras after that.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: El Kebeer is frightened by the spread of Johnny's election campaign posters throughout the Mazarita and tries to push the people of the town to vote for him and not for Johnny, but Johnny succeeds in gaining new lands, and the final blow comes to El Kebeer when he saves a man from suicide, and Johnny wins a sweep and becomes the new mayor of Mazarita.‎

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: El Kebeer feels sad about his loss to Johnny, and Johnny begins to give his own touches to El Dawar, El Kebeer decides to take revenge on him by detaining Ashley with Fazaa', and Ashley succeeds in escaping him, and Johnny saves her, but he also detains Johnny, and the police pounce on the roundabout, so El Kebeer pretends that he teaches him the origins of verticality.‎

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: ‎On the occasion of Johnny's victory as mayor, a party is held in Mazarita, and he brings in the artist Nicole Saba to hold a concert, both Johnny and El Kebeer dispute over giving her an enjoyable experience during her stay in Mazarita, and El Kebeer overcomes him every time, whether in the use of weapons, food, or in roaming around the town, and Hediya sees them together, and tells her that he will marry Nicole.‎

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: ‎Nicole Saba retreats from holding her concert, which puts Johnny in an unenviable position in front of the people of the town, and El Kebeer and Nicole get closer and closer, which provokes jealousy in Hediya and decides to leave the house, then Nicole declares to El Kebeer that things will not work between them, and Hediya returns to the house, and Johnny discovers that Hegras sells fake tickets for the concert.‎

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: El Gott returns to obtain his expected revenge from El Kebeer and chooses Johnny to kill him, but Johnny suggests that they face off in a boxing match, and Johnny trains some movements so that he can defeat the cat, and indeed succeeds in defeating El Gott in a remarkable match in front of the people of the town, and greets him for what he has achieved.‎

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: ‎Johnny makes a big fuss when he enters the Internet in Mazarita despite El Kebeer's objection, as everyone in the house is forbidden to use the Internet, and at the same time,  El Kebeerdecides to learn to use the Internet hidden from view.‎

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: ‎A mysterious chest is found in the roundabout, with mysterious writing on it, and both the great and Johnny try to decipher it to reach the treasure contained in this box to open it, but they find two gold pounds in it.‎

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: ‎Johnny decides to launch a television channel for Mazarita, and when El Kebeer notices Johnny's secrecy and his remorse with his regrets, he gets Hagras to admit the channel, so the great also plans to launch a channel in secret, and Johnny's channel begins to broadcast with lukewarm reactions towards its content, and El Kebeer decides to announce his channel suddenly in the dead of night.‎

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: El Kebeer channel is a great success and tremendously popular among the people of Al-Mazarita, which makes Johnny revolve around himself and think about a way to make his channel successful, so he tries to enter a talk show, but he fails in front of the Mazarita program today, which is presented by El Kebeer and Hediya, and they host the singer Fatima Eid, and Johnny tries to get ads for the channel, and in return El Kebeer is funded by a Saudi investor.‎

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: ‎Johnny thinks about opening a gift shop on the occasion of Valentine's Day in Mazarita, but the shop does not receive any significant demand, and Hediya tries to pamper El Kebeer on the occasion of Valentine, and Fazza decides to buy from Ashley a doll, and gives it to her when he surprises her in her room and tells her his feelings, but she tells him that she has a lover in America, and he feels sad, and the gift brought by Hediya burns, and El Kebeer tries to compensate her.‎

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: ‎Ashley talks about her belief in the horoscopes, so El Kebeer sees that his horoscope tells him that he will face a lot of bad luck, and as soon as he leaves the door of the house, he faces many embarrassing situations, and he is forced to change his robes more than once, and his suspicion increases more and more with everyone around him, and in the end, the people of the roundabout hold a surprise party for his birthday.‎

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: ‎After a long absence, Samantha, the mother of the American elder, comes to town, and the Mazarita turns upside down, El Kebeer feels ashamed of her and awe of her, and she succeeds in changing Hadiya's style in clothing and beauty until El Kebeer is surprised by her vision, and she leaves the town and returns after marrying a young man younger than her.‎

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: El Kebeer feels embarrassed in front of everyone after his mother's marriage, and a number of residents in the roundabout discover the theft of their mobile phones, and they suspect Samantha's husband's Hamada, and El Kebeer and Fazza decide to trap him, and he admits that he is wanted in fraud cases, and Samantha decides to return to America, and El Kebeer bids her farewell and buys her a gift Jalabiya.‎

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: ‎Thomas asks El Kebeer for some information that he will need for the scientific research he is doing to obtain a CFA certificate, so Hadiya thinks that Thomas works as a spy for foreign parties, as she accidentally saw several pictures taken by Thomas of many areas in Al-Mazarita, El Kebeer informs El Kebeer and recommends him to go to the Egyptian Secret agent to report Thomas, so he goes and reports him, and El Kebeer discovers that he made a mistake.‎

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: El Kebeer tells his wife Hadiya that they made a mistake against Thomas and he was not a spy as they thought, and suddenly an answer appeared to them sent from outside Egypt to Thomas, so he doubted them again, El Kebeer contacted Mohsen Bey and told him what was going on, so El Kebeer thought that Fazzaa is Secret agent, Mohsen Bey apologizes to Thomas and tells El Kebeer that it is very simple and that Thomas is doing a research and sends via the laptop the American teacher who supervises this research‎

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: ‎Johnny stays up with Thomas in one of the agricultural lands after feeling bored, then the owner of the land comes and watches with them and his friends and then the rest of the men of the village, Johnny opens a new casino on the ground and puts the name of Mazarita for him, which angered El Kebeer, so the latter increases the number of working hours of the people of Mazarita to exhaust them, and therefore they do not go to the casino owned by Johnny, the big buys the land and closes the casino.‎

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: ‎Johnny, Ashley, and Thomas have a fever from eating prickly pears, at the same time that Soo, the younger sister of Thomas and Ashley reaches the roundabout, an authoritarian girl, forces El Kebeer and Hadiya to take care of the small, but her style with them and the way she spoke did not impress them, so they decided to punish her by not taking care of her, which made her self-reliant and became a copy of the Upper Egyptian girl.‎

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Al-Tamarji Fahim, the brother of Al-Ghafir Fazza, lies in front of his fiancée's family and claims that his brother is the mayor of the village of Mazarita. He also claims that he is a doctor who convinces Fazza both Johnny and Hadiya to impersonate the mayor when Fahim's fiancée and her father visit El Kebeer's house when El Kebeer returns home, he learns what happened, which angers him.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Hajj Rajab calls El Kebeer and tells him about his partnership with his father and then tells him the story of his father's marriage to Mahitase.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Johnny talks to his American friend, the American football player, and Johnny dares to challenge him in the game and tells him that he can beat him because he has the best team in Africa, the Mazarita team, and then discovers that no one in Egypt practices this game, to gather a team of Mazarita people.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Johnny continues to prepare his new team to enter an American football game with an American professional team, and Johnny meets the coach of the other team, who mocks Johnny and offers him to withdraw, but Johnny insists on playing the game.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The Mazarita team plays its upcoming match with the American team (Sharek) and the Mazarita team succeeds in keeping pace with the American team, but the latter excels with the factor of experience and excessive strength, and the American team is close to winning the match, then El Kebeer Oy intervenes to save the Mazarita team and score the winning goal.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Johnny begins to search for the girl of his dreams in the village of his father and grandparents Mazarita and finds a girl and admires her deeply and then goes to her father to marry her and agrees with him on the costs of marriage.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The girl's father takes advantage of the position, family and lineage of Johnny and imposes too many requests on him to win his daughter, so the elder and Hadiya decide to meet her father and agree with him on the costs, after the agreement Johnny finds that the girl he loves is the cousin of the girl he will marry.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Jaber's uncle asked El Kebeer Awi for sick leave, which was rejected by El Kebeer, which made Jaber's uncle repeat "Hasbia Alla Wa Nea'm alwakiil" in the face of El Kebeer more than once and what was from El Kebeer but pushed him from the top of the ladder roundabout fell uncle Jaber fainted and suffers from memory loss, which made him remember that he is someone in every short period.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: An employee comes from a company to El Kebeer and tells him that El Kebeer awe has bought shares on the stock exchange and after his death, the heirs must receive the shares or sell them for six million pounds, the employee believes that El Kebeer is the heir of the only El Kebeer awe, so El Kebeer thinks to seize the share of his brother and tells him that he is the only heir, the big watches the movie (Face Off) before sleeping and then watches a scary dream that makes him retreat.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: El Kebeer discovers that his wife Hadiya is pregnant, and Johnny has received an e-mail from one of the film production companies in America stating that he succeeded in the first stage of the competition conducted by the company to choose a hero for the film (Titanic 2), which is a race that brings together 9 other contestants on the condition that each of them embodies a scene in front of the jury.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Johnny had traveled to America at the beginning of the episode to star in the second part of the movie Titanic, but he surprised El Kebeer and returned at the end of the episode to bless him, and appeared at the end of the episode Hazelom to ask the great and Johnny his right to inherit as he is their third twin.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: El Kebeer goes down to talk to his wife Hediya and a call comes to him on the mobile phone telling him that the animals were stolen, so he goes to find Fazza playing and tells him that the reason for this is his brother Hazelum, who asked the guards to leave the guard and leave.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Police cars surround the house of the beast's thief, and after the exchange of gunfire, the thieves come out with Hazelum as a hostage after El Kebeer is sure that he has gotten rid of Hazelum and leaves him hostage to them, he is surprised to be in the house, and at the same time Johnny returned and told them about the memories of the movie Titanic 2.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Hajres comes and rejoices at Johnny's return and goes down with him to meet the people of the country and when he goes to ride his motorcycle, he is surprised that it does not work and leaves it to Hazelom until he repairs it, so he takes off the brakes, and when Johnny rides him, an accident occurs to him, after which Hazleum tries to apologize for what he caused.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Unintentionally, Hazelom breaks Johnny's vessel with his teacher's ashes inside. Hence, he gets furious and agrees with El Kebeer on a plan to get rid of Hazelom and tells him that he must take revenge and go to Cairo to escape from this person.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Hazelum returns to his house and tells El Kebeer that he killed Said Zalata, so El Kebeer takes him in a car, and puts him inside the trunk after he moves the car and is in the middle of the road, it becomes clear that Hazelom got out of the car, to enter the bathroom, and Hediya calls him to tell him and a car crashes into him.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Fazza comes to tell El Kebeer that there is a tourist bus that broke down in front of his house, so El Kebeer agrees to host them and discovers that they are all women, when Johnny sees them, he takes Fazza and Hajars and invites the driver to food until he gets away from the bus and then dismantles the bus to disrupt them from leaving.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Hediya wakes up to a call telling her that her grandfather's father has died, so she travels to mourn and brings her aunt Ghawayesh to take care of the children, on the other hand, Johnny trains the Mazarita men in yoga exercises.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: El Nadaha calls out to one of the Mazarita men, and he asks Johnny about her, Hediya tells him some stories, but he is unbelievable and insists that he goes at night and spends a night by the canal, so Hajras.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A group of photographers and directors enter El Kebeer and ask him to play the role of a Saidi man in a film about a group of drug dealers, during that, El Kebeer carries these boxes and trips, so the box falls from it and shows the fact that it contains drugs.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: El Kebeer talks to a businessman who owns the largest juice manufacturing factory and wants his first production to be cane juice, so he invites him to spend two days at home to see for himself the cane crop.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Hegras goes to Johnny to ask him to translate a letter from a foreign girl who sent him a friend request named Natasha, and tells him that she likes him and that she will come to Mazarita to see him, Johnny thinks that she will be old or ugly, but she is very beautiful.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: A group of Johnny's friends came from America and threatened him that he bought a house from them in America for a hundred thousand dollars and then returned it to them and took the money again and then demolished the house, so they came to him to take the money from him.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: El Kebeer gets on the train to buy two tractors from Egypt and meets Sultan on the train and gives him aspirin for headaches, then Sultan descends and discovers that Sultan forgot his bag, so he takes 2 aspirins from his bag, two on the way and two on the stairs, and a day later, he finds himself in a women's bathroom inside a restaurant.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: El Kebeer is arrested for breaking into an ambush more than once, and he calls Hediya on the phone to bring him a lawyer to the station, he tells him that last night he also took him out of the station unconscious after he hit a taxi driver and broke his car.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Johnny disappears and the center is informed, and an informant comes to conduct investigations and interrogates everyone, the first of which is Hajres because he is the first person to find his shoes.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Hediya becomes depressed because El Kebeer one forgot an important occasion on 1-4, the day when El Kebeer one told her that he loved her, and she tells Johnny the love story between them and how they knew each other after he almost hit her with his car, and how he liked her and bonded with her and fought her cousin to marry her.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: El Kebeer's car breaks down on the road, and he meets a young man who refuses to help him and throws him into the canal and runs in his car, and when El Kebeer goes to Al-Mazarita, he finds this young man's car, breaks his car and beats him.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The doctor refuses to proceed with the permission to discharge El Kebeer until after he is cured and stays in the hospital, and the lawyer comes and tells him that he is expected to stay in the hospital for almost several years, so El Kebeer beats him and brings them the idea of escaping.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Blisters appear on the face of El Kebeer, and when he goes to the doctor, he asks him for some tests, and after showing them to him, he tells him that he is sick with a rare disease and will only live for a month.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: She asks El Kebeer to bring her a maid to help her at home, he refuses at first but accepts in the end, and more than one comes: the first is a thief, the second sleeps a lot, and the third is very gloomy, so they have to resort to the servers.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The journey of searching for a suitable maid continues, so Saeed Al-Makhdahi brings a foreign maid, so El Kebeer does not like her and is afraid of her because she always looks at him in a strange way, so he dreams that he tried to kill her to get rid of her, he finds an idea to get rid of her, so he tries to make a gift that thinks that there is something between them, so she expels her from the house.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: El Kebeer returns to childhood, so he begins to buy toys for him and plays ball in the street with the children, and Hediya begins to doubt him on the belief that he is married to others after seeing several children's toys hiding under the bed, but she discovers this disease she and Johnny from the village doctor.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: A large number of children are poisoned in a school, and they are filmed and neglected around them from every side, and the program Bassem Youssef deals with this topic sarcastically, so the elder is kidnapped after Youssef and takes him to Mazarita,El Kebeer asks Bassem Youssef to film Mazarita after making adjustments to it so that it appears properly.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: El Kebeer goes to Dr. Mazarita to help him do something to grow hair on his head and gives him a cream to help with the hair transplant process.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Johnny knows that Hediya has a talent for singing and wishes to participate in the talent show (Arab Got Talent) and encourages her and films a clip for her without the knowledge of El Kebeer and sends it to the program she succeeds, and when they come to film with her, El Kebeer knows and expels them.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Fazza and many of the people of Mazarita apply to the program (Mazarita has Talent) and El Kebeer goes masked so that Johnny does not know him and presents in the program, El Kebeer goes to the culture center of Mazarita to agree with one of the trainers to make a dance for the great, and the great begins to do many exercises.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: The first episode of the program (Al-Mazarita gotTalent) begins with the presence of the jury of Johnny, Razan Mughrabi, and Imad Barour, and Hagras presents the program, showing many talents, including Ashraf and Fazza.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The competition continues in the program (Mazarita has Talent) and the contestants present other performances El Kebeer manages a prank on Fazza so that he cannot sing, in the end, the winner is announced, which is Ashraf.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: The mother of El Kebeer returns from America and surprises them that she will marry and El Kebeer surprise is that the groom is a scarecrow, El Kebeer refuses strongly, but in front of his mother's insistence, he cannot do anything so he tries to cut the wedding dress and the groom's suit.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: El Kebeer lawyer comes to him to tell him that the tax case against his father has been won by taxes, and the house and land will be auctioned off and they will all start collecting money to collect the amount of taxes.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Al-Kabir has a nightmare where his brother Hazal'oum takes control of everything and humiliates him in front of the village's people. Al-Kabir and Johnny plot to get their shares of the fortune back, as Hazal'oum wakes up and starts giving gifts to his family and telling them his tale.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Hazal'oum tells his brothers about meeting the wealthy Nawaf who wanted to marry his mother. But his mother slips into a coma during plastic surgery, Hazal'oum accidentally pulls out her life support. Johnny is upset when Hazal'oum turns his room into a jungle and keeps a pet crocodile in the bathtub.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A villager asks Hazal'oum to accompany him to propose to a girl. But as Hazal'oum starts talking to the bride's father, it's revealed that the bride is the man's mother, not his daughter.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Hazal'oum enlists the help of a cosmetics specialist to prepare him for his appearance with Motaz El Demerdash. El-Kabir is jealous and tries to appear on any TV show.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Al-Kabir appears on Sherif Madkour's show, not knowing that it's a cooking show. When he discovers the truth, he tries to get back at the guy who secured him the guest spot, only for the guy to meet Hazal'oum who recounts the story of how a Tanzanian tribe tried to kill him.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: When Samantha forces Al-Kabir to get Fazaa' a gift for his birthday, Al-Kabir gets him a snake which drives him into hysterics. Hazal'oum tells them about how the chief of a Tanzanian tribe was accidentally killed instead of him.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When Al-Kabir overhears Hazal'oum and his lawyer talk about selling the land and the house, he plots with Johnny and Hadya to stop him and steal the contract. He quickly discovers that Hazal'oum only meant to distribute the property between them.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: When Al-Kabir discovers that Samantha is pregnant, he pulls all the stops to get Fazaa' to divorce her. He gets what he wants when the pregnancy turns out to be false.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As Al-Kabir looks for a replacement for Fazaa', Thomas returns and reconciles with Johnny. As the two discuss some ideas for a project, Hazal'oum advises them to open a Koshary place. Johnny is shocked when Hazal'oum opens a Koshary place of his own.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Johnny reprimands Thomas for taking his ideas and passing them to Hazal'oum. As a fierce competition grows between Johnny and Hazal'oum, the three brothers discover that Thomas has robbed them. Al-Kabir tortures him.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Johnny receives a birthday cake as a gift but soon discovers that it's made of cannabis. He goes to the police station when he is informed that his stolen beach buggy has been found used as a Tok Tok, leaving the cake behind, only for the family to eat it and get high.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: With Al-Kabir expecting a visit from the governor to decide if he'll continue as the village's mayor or not, three patients who were just discharged from a psychiatric hospital arrive and threaten to expose him.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The governor and Al-Kabir tour the village as the governor tries to decide to keep Al-Kabir as mayor or not. The three psychiatric patients escape Baa'zak and cause trouble.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: A doctor arrives at the house and demands Al-Kabir hands over the fugitive trio. When Al-Kabir double-crosses him, he reports him to the cops. But one of the psychiatric patients tells the cops that the governor and his men are the escaped patients.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Al-Kabir tells Johnny the story of their grandfather, Al-Kabir Gedan, who left Mazarita for Cairo. When a group of criminals took hold of the village, the village's elder asked Al-Kabir Gedan for help, and he returned with three fierce men to confront the criminals.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: When Al-Kabir Gedan's men die in an explosion, he decides to train the villagers to fight the criminals. When he accidentally kills them all, he enlists the help of some old friends.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: As Al-Kabir Gedan gathers his old friends, he seeks the help of a recluse man who lives in the jungle called Ardash. The group of friends set up military traps for the criminals but Al-Kabir Gedan disapproves of all of their plans.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: When Al-Kabir Gedan manages to chase the criminals off, his celebration with the villagers is so raucous that they all pass out after drinking. They all shocked to discover that the criminals' boss took advantage of their inebriation and took charge of the village.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: After Mar'ei disarms Al-Kabir and his men and kicks them out of the village, they encounter a military vehicle full of weapons that they seize to fight Mar'ei.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: When a bird carrying a tracking device is found in Mazarita, the media accuses it of being a spy after a group of foreigners asks after it. As intelligence agencies get involved, it's revealed that the foreigners are working for an international organization tracking bird activity.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: As Hadya tries to convince a reluctant Johnny to marry one of her friends, her cousin Saleh returns from Italy. Al-Kabir grows jealous because he knows that Saleh wanted to marry Hadya.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: As Al-Kabir grows more jealous, he fights with Saleh who falls down the stairs. Al-Kabir flirts with Hadya after she learns that Saleh wants to get back at Al-Kabir for marrying her.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Johnny decides to make a local song after listening to one. He uploads it to social media and is met with great success.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Johnny convinces Al-Kabir to accept his invitation to a resort along with Hadya, Samantha and the rest of them. Johnny deliberately arrives late to force Al-Kabir to pay for the hotel.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: The family enjoys their vacation in Marina, but Johnny is upset with their humiliating actions. He decides to leave without telling them and tells the hotel to make Al-Kabir pay the bill.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Al-Kabir, Hadya, Ashraf, and Hagras go to a nightclub and meet Samantha and Dr. Rabe'. They unknowingly drink wine.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Al-Kabir discovers that Rabe' and Samantha got married while drunk and forces Rabe' to divorce her. But Rabe' proposes to her again and Al-Kabir tries to sabotage the marriage.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: When Samantha reprimands Al-Kabir for trying to sabotage her marriage, Al-Kabir goes blind. The governor suggests that he gives up the mayorship to either Johnny or Hazal'oum.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Fazaa' begs Al-Kabir to rehire him. Fazaa' tells him that the mayorship has been transferred to Hazal'oum. When Al-Kabir falls down the stairs, his sight is restored but he hides the fact from his family. Instead, he gathers them to tell them that he wants to make Fazaa' the mayor.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Al-Kabir plots with Fazaa' to teach his family a lesson. He reveals that he is no longer blind and tries to leave Mazarita but they convince him to stay. The family is shocked when a new Sudanese brother arrives and demands his share of the inheritance.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Both Hazalqoum and Al-Kabeer receive their Sudanese brother, Naim, who is characterized by a very lazy personality.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The old man agrees on the amount he will get in return for his and his brothers giving up their share in the Turkish pharmaceutical company, gets a small amount in cash and leaves, while two thieves track him down.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Al-Kabir regains consciousness and discovers that he has lost his memory, and the nurse takes care of him, while Hazalkoum comes to Turkey and goes to his friend who is a gang leader and asks him to help him find his brother.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The elder learns Turkish, and later he hears a noise in the next apartment, so he goes there and finds a girl trying to commit suicide.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Hazalkoum's assistant discovers that there is a traitor among them who caused the death of their former leader Yuri, while the old man shows admiration for his neighbor, who goes out for a walk with her.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Al-Kabeer works as a janitor in Papa Duplass's boxing hall. Later he takes a walk with his neighbor, who suggests that he go to the Egyptian Embassy after Papa Duplass tells him that his accent is Egyptian.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sasha's wife admires Hazalqoum, while one of the boxing champions taunts the elder while he is cleaning the floor of the hall, which angers him and makes him ask for his fight.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Sarouf Bey, a gang leader in Turkey, discovers that Al-Kabir is having an affair with his daughter.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The elder fights and defeats many boxers, while Johnny calls Hazalqoum and asks him for an update regarding the elder's whereabouts.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Al-Kabir and Hazalqoum suffer superficial injuries during their confrontation with each other, while Sasha goes to Al-Kabir and tries to persuade him to hand Sarouf Bey over.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Al-Kabeer marries Sarouf Bey's daughter and hides with her, but Lotfi finds him and asks him to work with him again amid the Kabeer's refusal.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: El Kabeer trains in Papa Duplass's arena until he is ready to battle Roman, while the two opponents later stand face to face on the ring in the betting hall in the presence of El Kabeer's wife and Papa Duplass, as well as Sarouf Beck.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Sasha and Hazalqoum storm the boxing hall and manage to defeat Sarouf Bey and his gang, while the elder falls to the ground during the confrontation and hits his head on the ground, causing a surprise.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Johnny and Hagras stay in a hotel, and later they harass a woman, so her husband comes and scolds them. On the other hand, while Johnny Wagers is golfing, Johnny makes a powerful throw that leads the ball into one of the hotel rooms and the unexpected happens.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Johnny is sentenced in a murder case to life imprisonment with hard labor.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Johnny changes his name inside the prison to Boraei and befriends one of the prisoners, and while he is eating food, the latter unintentionally throws him at the generosity of the leader of the prisoners who quarrels with him and the officer sees them and puts them in solitary confinement.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: After he is caught red-handed in the criminal's den, the elder is imprisoned, while the sheriff rewards Johnny for his efficiency at work, while Hazelqum visits the elder and together they plan to smuggle him and Johnny from prison.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Hazalqoum and Ashraf plot a plot that will allow the latter to enter the prison, while Johnny and the elder plot a plan to steal the key to the sheriff's office.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Hazalqoum imprisoned Hagras, Baazaq, and Dr. Rabei on charges of theft in order to help the elder escape, and every time they tried to escape, they were caught and held in solitary confinement.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The great, Ashraf, Hagras, Azak and Rabie perform Hamlet on the prison stage, and in the end scene, everyone disappears under the stage in order to escape.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Karam and Al-Kabeer cooperate in implementing a plan through which they disguise themselves as policemen and try to escape from prison, while the owner of the den in which the elder was present at the moment of his arrest appears red-handed.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Hajres opens a small grocery store, and later suggests that Johnny return to acting, with Hazalkoum producing the film for him.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Hazalqoum decides to take El-Kabeer's villa as a location for filming his new movie, but El-Kabeer refuses to do so.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Johnny encounters the low standards of the actress chosen by Hazalqoum to play the lead role in front of him, while that actress named Nour celebrates with Hazalkoum before the start of shooting the new movie.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: During the filming of the new movie, however, Al-Kabeer's arrival at the filming site prompts everyone to flee the villa, while the latter is impressed by the actress Nour, who asks him to participate in the title role instead of Johnny.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: A giant meteorite will hit the Earth and Cairo, the Greater, within a week, and it consists of a substance that earth scientists know nothing about, and no research has been submitted about it except for Hazalqoum, so an Egyptian team for space science resorts to Hazalqoum in order to detonate that meteorite in space.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: The Egyptian astronaut Mamdouh gets to know Hazalqoum's team and conducts medical and psychological tests on them, but they fail. They have recently been chosen to carry out the meteor explosion mission. Indeed, the team inside the space shuttle is preparing for takeoff into space.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Hazalqoum and his team launch into space and while they land on the surface of the meteor, the transmission between them and the ground station is cut off, so they decide to send nuclear missiles to detonate the meteor.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Hazalqoum quarrels with Mamdouh about the means used to dig the meteorite, then Mamdouh leaves them for the shuttle in an attempt to contact Earth, and finds the shuttle commander Ali complaining about the damage to the shuttle.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Hazalqoum and his team manage to plant the bomb in the middle of the meteorite as planned, but they do not know how to detonate the bomb after the detonator is destroyed.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As Al Kabeer tries to take care of his two sons, Johnny suffers from obesity. Meanwhile, Al Kabeer discovers that Dr. Rabea is using Ashraf in an experiment of producing milk to fatten calves.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: When Al Kabeer's son, Al-Etraa takes the calf-fattening drink of Dr. Rabea, he turns into an adult man. Meanwhile, Al Kabeer receives threats to have the mayor's position withdrawn from him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As Al Kabeera Faht, Al Kabeer's aunt arrives, and forces him to marry Marboha, Johnny leaves Al-Mazareeta, hoping to lose weight.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Al Kabeer marries Marboha in a big wedding. When Johnny returns to Al-Mazareeta after losing weight in record time, he accidentally injures a singer at the wedding.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Al Kabeer spends a rough first night with his wife, Marboha, Johnny reveals the secret of his weight loss to Hagras. Al Kabeer tells Marboha about the prohibited things in his house.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As Al Kabeer disguises himself as Santa Claus to reveal the irregularities in Al-Mazareeta, Marboha suffers from the repeated pranks of Al-Etraa and little Johnny.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Al Kabeer wakes up and finds himself kidnapped with the people of Al-Mazareeta in a competitive game called "Squid Game", during which the loser dies. Marboha saves Al Kabeer during the first round.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: As Al Kabeer and his team pass the second challenge, he is replaced by his team with Hagras. Meantime, Al Kabeer moves to Fazzaa's team, and the two teams succeed in passing the third challenge in "Squid Game".

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As Al Kabeer and his team overcome the fourth challenge in "Squid Game", a new challenge begins where each one faces the other.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Al Kabeer discovers who is behind this whole "Squid Game" thing.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Hazaloom returns to Al-Mazareeta and tells Al Kabeer and Johnny about the story of his son Halqoom, and he asks for their help to find his mother.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Hazaloom goes to meet his ex-wives, Amaino and Amjaad, to try to find out the identity of the mother of his son Halqoom. The latter disappears, then Al Kabeer orders his men to search for him in Al-Mazareeta.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Al Kabeer searches for the thief in his house, and Hazaloom visits his ex-wife, Nermin Al-Fiqy, and refuses to return her to his infallibility. Hazaloom discovers that Halqoom is not his son, but the son of the driver who made up the story to steal Hazaloom.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Al Kabeer fails to protect Al-Etraa from bullying by his classmate Jalila, and during a school play Al-Etraa stands next to Jalila after she suffers an accident and teaches her a lesson in tolerance.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Al Kabeer quarrels with Marboha, and Johnny uses Hagras to film clips of charitable deeds for the purpose of publishing them on social networking sites.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Al Kabeer mocks Marboha for not caring about her appearance and clothes, and Hegras and Johnny compete to achieve the highest viewership ratings on their social networking channel.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Johnny makes a plan with profitable assistance to expose Hegras and his women's relationships on social media, and Hagras comes up with a video accusing Johnny of espionage.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Al Kabeer prevents Johnny from selling his land to buy followers for his channel, and succeeds in forcing him to get rid of his internet addiction, while the relationship between Johnny and Hagras improves.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Samantha visits Al Kabeer and his family, and while she gets to know Marboha, she seeks to encourage the women of Al-Mazareeta to demand their rights, and Al Kabeer locked Marboha in her room, so demonstrations take place calling for her liberation.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Al Kabeer and Hagras try to defend the male position against the women of Al-Mazareeta in a live broadcast, and Marboha submits the women's requests for infidelity, and Al Kabeer agrees to them amid Samantha's objections.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Hazaloom sends a group of gifts to Al Kabeer and his family, and Al-Etraa gets a gift represented in a mysterious doll that causes many terrifying phenomena in Al Kabeer's house.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: The evil spirit inside the doll possesses the body of Al-Etraa, and Al Kabeer seeks a way to expel the spirit from his son's body, so the spirit turns him into a monkey.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Johnny and Hagras take advantage of Al-Labbad by appearing in a live broadcast on their channel, and Al Kabeer succeeds in removing the spirit from the body of Al-Etraa with the help of a Jamaican band.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Al Kabeer discovers the great wealth that Fazzaa is hiding, and the farmers of the Al Kabeer's land turn against him because of Madkoor, so he decides to take care of his land with his family.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Al Kabeer succeeds in exposing Madkoor's plan to seize the people's money and escape, and Al Kabeer agrees to the demands of Tabaza and the farmers to return to work on the land and return their stolen money.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Al Kabeer decides to organize a major film festival in Al-Mazareeta, and Hazaloom is responsible for persuading celebrities to attend the festival.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Johnny stops the journalists' car in order to be alone in the media coverage of Al-Mazareeta festival, and Al Kabeer reveals a person impersonating the actor Leonardo DiCaprio.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Art stars flock to Al-Mazareeta Film Festival, and Johnny, Hagras and Marboha cover the event.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: The artist Eyad Nassar arrives at the festival and suffers from the ignorance of Johnny and Hagras and their lack of knowledge of him, Meanwhile Al Kabeer is trying to get closer to the artist Sherine Reda.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Johnny disguises himself as the actor Leonardo DiCaprio in an attempt to save the festival, and the ploy is revealed by the arrival of the real actor, and the party ends with the guests fleeing and the police arresting Mohamed Sallam instead of Hagras.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Al Kabeer experiences boredom in his life after his marriage to Marbouha. Johnny moves forward with his plan to open a gym.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After overhearing one of Al Kabeer’s phone calls, Marbouha enlists the help of Johnny and Hagras to unlock his phone and find out if he's cheating on her.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Johnny is disappointed to find out that people don’t care to use his gym the way he intended. Al Kabeer and Marbouha’s marriage counselling session goes badly for her.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: After they failed at fulfilling her first assignment, the doctor suggests that Al Kabeer and Marbouha try something new but various issues get in their way.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In a final attempt to save their marriage, Al Kabeer and Marbouha listen to Jameela and travel to Cairo to escape the routine causing their constant fights.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As their next stop in touring Cairo, Al Kabeer takes Marbouha to a mall. But when he leaves her alone for a moment, her innocence puts her in grave danger.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: While Al Kabeer and Nafadi follow the available leads to find her, Marbouha looks for a way to escape Fakhri’s house.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Al Kabeer interrogates Ahmed ElSaka to see if he is Marbouha’s kidnapper, while she despairs at ever being saved.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: When Johnny finds himself in need of money, Hagras shows him how to get it through social media and followers.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: When their video reaches millions of views, Johnny visits Shourou’ who gives him an an idea that could increase the number of their followers and earn them more money.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Johnny tells Marbouha the truth about his engagement and swears her to secrecy. Shourou’ and Johnny’s plan is a success, but she takes it a step too far.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: When Johnny tries to get out of his deal with Shourou’, she reminds him of the papers he signed. To Al Kabeer’s displeasure, the couple throw an engagement party.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: When Etra gets into trouble during a karate competition, Al Kabeer asks Dr. Rabee’ for the potion that will bring his son back to normal.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: After seeing Etra in his new state, Al Kabeer returns to Dr. Rabi’ for revenge. Johnny and Hagras hold auditions for their play.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Al Kabeer sends his men to search for Dr. Rabi’. Etra has a health setback. Johnny finds out that Hagras is taking bribes from people looking to act in the play.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Al Kabeer pursues his search for Dr. Rabi’. During the first rehearsal, the script chosen by Hagras seems familiar to Johnny.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: When Johnny finds out that Etra’s lie got the media’s attention, he decides to use it to his advantage, unaware of the incoming danger. Al Kabeer gets a new formula.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Hazalqoum gets his hands on a failing sock factory and discovers, on his first visit, the multiple issues he must deal with. Later, he runs into his arch nemesis.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: When Farouq crashes his TV interview, Hazalqoum makes a large bet against him. Then, realizing the mistake he just made, he seeks Al Kabeer and Nafadi's help to fix it.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: After training the new players of Al Mazarita FC, Rabi’ proposes organizing a friendly match to test them. Hazalqoum tries to affect the outcome of the game.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Right when Hazalqoum is about to back out on the bet, Al Kabeer decides to help him. Hagras’ plea to join the team having been rejected, he seeks revenge.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: As the match begins, Hagras’ betrayal hits the team and the residents of Al Mazarita hard, but the latter is hiding a secret that could change the outcome of the game.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Al Kabeera returns to Al Mazarita with important news to share with her nephews. Al Kabeer finds out that his arch nemesis is in town and starts searching for him.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Johnny asks for Hagras’ help to make an impression on Al Kabeera’s fiancé, while Al Kabeer goes to extremes to find out who he is.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Hofny El Dib arrives to Al Dawar to ask for Al Kabeera’s hand in marriage, but Johnny’s unfamiliarity with local traditions slows down the proceedings.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: After his various attempts at coming between Hofny and Al Kabeera fail, Al Kabeer decides to kill him, unaware that someone else has a similar plan.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Al Kabeer sets his plan to get rid of Hofny in motion. Just when he is about to succeed, armed men crash the wedding.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: When he finds himself stuck in a tough situation, Mohamed Sallam remembers what happened to him during the Mazarita film festival and pays Hagras a visit.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Sallam is arrested by Al Kabeer for Hagras’ crimes while the latter gets a visit from Al Prince.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Hagras starts shooting his series “Al Kabeer,” inspired by his life. Johnny and Sallam sneak onto the set to get their revenge.
